svg.title: Voltstream sequence: daily billing
svg.desc: At simulated midnight the tariff feed writes tariff_D.csv. Airflow, polling every minute, triggers billing for D, waits for the file and a 90 s grace, then runs the billing job: ledger running, read day D and its tariff, bill, and commit the bills with a success row in one transaction. Airflow verifies 50 bills, then runs the rollup, reconciliation and report. The API now returns the final bill.
